comparison.objective: Connect a flexible sensor cable to a ZIF connector; candidate commissions and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Open a tiny latch, grasp a flex cable mid-length, slide it fully into a zero-force slot, hold it seated, and close the latch bimanually; candidate seats a hex bit, loosens a captive screw, rotates a collar, reacquires the socket, and tightens.
comparison.success_condition: Latch must be opened before insertion and closed while the cable remains seated; the record gives no numeric seating/latch tolerances. Candidate further requires quantified dynamic validation over two cycles.
comparison.reason: Both feature ordered unlock-manipulate-relock actions, but ZIF flex insertion tests compliant-part handling and latch coordination, whereas the candidate tests rotary adjustment plus empirical damper commissioning.
